content: This medication may increase your sensitivity to sunlight, particularly if you have pre-existing skin conditions such as atopic dermatitis or eczema. It is advisable to limit your exposure to sunlight, avoid tanning booths and sunlamps, and use sunscreen along with protective clothing when outdoors. This medication is chemically similar to aspirin. Children and teenagers under the age of 18 should not take aspirin or aspirin-related medications (such as salicylates) if they have chickenpox, the flu, any undiagnosed illness, or if they have recently received a vaccine, as this could increase the risk of serious complications. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if absolutely necessary and prescribed by a healthcare provider. It is known to pass into breast milk and may have undesirable effects on a nursing infant. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. It is important to maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication is similar to other drugs such as balsalazide, olsalazine, and sulfasalazine. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as urine normetanephrine levels, potentially leading to false test results. Inform your healthcare provider and laboratory personnel if you are taking this medication. In the event of an overdose, if the individual experiences severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services immediately (911 in the U.S.). Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as liver and kidney function tests, may be conducted before starting this medication and periodically during treatment to monitor your condition and check for side effects. Ensure you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. If the medication bottle contains a desiccant, keep the desiccant in the bottle. Ensure the bottle is tightly closed when not in use. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
